summary: Join our Health and Safety Legislation course to master essential policies. Equip yourself with the knowledge to promote a safe and compliant work environment.
lede: Health and safety legislation training helps safety officers, managers, and compliance professionals interpret applicable legal duties and turn them into workplace policies. Participants learn to clarify responsibilities, review policies against legislative expectations, and connect risk assessments and incident reporting with legal requirements in practice for their organization.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who influence or own responsibility for health and safety decisions and policies.
audience: Health and Safety Officers and HSE coordinators
Compliance, risk, and internal audit professionals
modules: Foundations of Health and Safety Legislation
Key Health and Safety Policies and Core Requirements
Risk Assessment and Control Measures in Law
Incident Reporting, Investigation, and Legal Implications
Enforcement, Penalties, and Case Law Lessons
Building a Compliant Health and Safety Management System
Communicating, Training, and Embedding Health and Safety Policies
prerequisites: No prior legal training is required, but a basic understanding of workplace safety principles is beneficial. Participants should be in roles with responsibilities for health and safety or compliance.
